content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Usdt payment

A USDT payment gateway for digital products is a self-hosted system that accepts Tether (USDT) payments directly from buyers, verifies transactions on-chain, and delivers products automatically. Unlike Stripe or Gumroad, this stack runs on infrastructure you own. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. NOWPayments verifies USDT payments. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. No platform locks you in. No fees beyond 0.5%. You keep 99.5% of every sale. This is infrastructure sovereignty — built for creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or hostile.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack begins with a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Buyers select a product and pay in USDT via NOWPayments. The payment triggers a webhook that fires the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script verify the payment, log the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and generate a secure download link. The buyer receives the link instantly. The system is stateless, serverless, and fully automated. No databases to manage. No servers to maintain. The entire stack costs $0 to run unless a sale occurs. This is lean, pressure-tested architecture — built in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse is the norm.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Payhip are unavailable or severely restricted. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, or the Philippines, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who refuse to pay 10% platform fees. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, switching from Gumroad to NOWPayments retains $921. This is not a workaround. It’s a permanent upgrade to your commerce infrastructure.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per sale. Gumroad charges 10%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you retain $921 more.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack combines free and paid tools into a unified system. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments verifies USDT payments with a 0.5% fee. Recommended networks for low transaction fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON — under $0.10 per transaction. Each component is replaceable. Each tool is open. You own the entire stack after deployment. COREMERCH has no access. No platform does. This is infrastructure you control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH. Both deploy in 48 hours. Both include NOWPayments integration, product loading, and 30-day support. Alternatively, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Deploy on your own infrastructure. Own the system. Scale as needed. This is not a temporary fix. It’s a permanent upgrade to your commerce architecture. Built for creators who choose sovereignty over platforms. Built for regions where payment rejection is the norm.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign USDT payment gateway. Host your storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments for USDT verification. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This stack eliminates platform fees, bypasses regional restrictions, and gives you full ownership of your commerce infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Lifetime access.
This stack is stateless, serverless, and fully automated. No databases to manage. No servers to maintain. Zero ongoing costs unless a sale occurs.

If you’re selling notion templates, fonts, or digital downloads and want to accept crypto payments without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need. Deploy a crypto-only digital download store at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Own your infrastructure. Keep 99.5% of every sale. This is how creators in regions locked out of Stripe and PayPal build sovereign commerce stacks.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Integrate NOWPayments for USDT payment verification. 4. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Upload products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase, verify payment, and confirm file delivery. 7. Deploy your stack. 8. Load your products. 9. Launch your store. 10. Keep 99.5% of every sale.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept multiple cryptocurrencies, not just USDT?
Yes. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Configure your payment gateway to accept BTC, ETH, SOL, or any other coin. Fees remain 0.5% per transaction. No KYC required. No buyer account needed.
What if a buyer sends the wrong amount of USDT?

NOWPayments automatically verifies the exact amount. If the payment is incorrect, the webhook does not fire, and the product is not delivered. The buyer must resend the correct amount. The system is fully automated and error-proof.
How do I handle refunds or chargebacks?

Refunds are handled manually by sending USDT back to the buyer’s wallet. Chargebacks are impossible with crypto payments. Once a transaction confirms on-chain, it is irreversible. This protects you from fraudulent disputes.
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploy in 48 hours with no coding required. Alternatively, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for step-by-step blueprints and templates. Full support is included.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

Your stack remains operational. NOWPayments is a verification layer, not a dependency. If their service is unavailable, payments will queue and process once it’s back online. Your storefront and file delivery systems continue functioning.
